dataset_name: Multi-Asset Real Equity Historical Indicators & Returns Dataset
domain: Quantitative Finance & Stock Market Machine Learning
collection_methodology: Aggregated from online financial market sources (Kaggle Financial Market Datasets & Public Market APIs: Yahoo Finance / NSE / S&P historical daily series) across 2022-2025
academic_use: ML CA1 & CA2 Solo Project Submission

features_dictionary.symbol: Ticker symbol (AAPL, MSFT, NVDA, JPM, HDFC, JNJ, AMZN, XOM)
features_dictionary.sector: GICS Market Sector (Technology, Financials, Healthcare, Consumer, Energy)
features_dictionary.close_price: Closing price on trade date in local currency (USD / INR)
features_dictionary.sma_ratio: Ratio of 50-Day Simple Moving Average to 200-Day SMA (Golden/Death cross indicator)
features_dictionary.beta: Sensitivity of asset returns relative to benchmark index (S&P 500 / NIFTY 50)
features_dictionary.earnings_growth_pct: Quarter-over-Quarter reported earnings per share growth (%)
features_dictionary.institutional_flow_idx: Order flow imbalance indicator (1: Strong Selling, 3: Neutral, 5: Heavy Institutional Inflow)
features_dictionary.volume_k: Daily trading volume measured in thousands of shares
features_dictionary.market_regime_cluster: Unsupervised K-Means Assigned Cluster (0: Bull Accumulation, 1: Consolidation, 2: Volatile Shock)
features_dictionary.target_next_price: Target variable (continuous): Realized subsequent closing price ($ / ₹)
features_dictionary.target_return_pct: Target variable (continuous): Realized subsequent percentage return (%)
